name: create_branch
description: Create a run-specific feature branch without resetting or overwriting any existing ref; every requested base name receives the stable execution suffix and local collisions receive a numeric suffix.

repoPath.description: Git checkout in which to create the branch.

name.description: Requested base branch name; receives a run-specific suffix and, on local collision, a numeric suffix.

branchRunId.description: Run identifier used to make the branch name unique; falls back to workflowId, then the task's workflow instance ID, then its task ID.

workflowId.description: Fallback run identifier used when branchRunId is not supplied.

forceNew.description: When true, always allocate a new branch even if the current branch already matches the requested name.

inPlace.description: When true, marks the outcome as an in-place branch operation in the response.

branch.description: Actual branch name created or resumed.

resumed.description: True when the current branch already matched the requested name and was reused instead of creating a new one.

inPlace.description: Present and true only when the inPlace input flag was set.
